description: This file defines a Java Data Transfer Object (DTO) named ExportDto for exporting a list of Book objects within the book project. It uses Lombok annotations for boilerplate code reduction and includes metadata annotations related to code coverage exclusion.

classes.name: ExportDto
classes.description: A DTO class that encapsulates a list of Book objects for export purposes. It is immutable due to the 'final' keyword on the books list and leverages Lombok's @Data for auto-generating getters, setters, and other utility methods.
